scientific_integrity: Proof gives an all-parameter exact matrix-inequality argument and explicit counterexample families. The supplemental rational checker tests specific configurations only and is not a proof of universal quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic two-coordinate real symmetric positive-definite matrices with minimum eigenvalue greater than one; guarantees only the unweighted discrete potential and its sign-optimality correspondence. Not a higher-dimensional or nonsymmetric theorem; the converse is existential, not universal failure. Full historical priority is not independently certified.
title: Sharp symmetric-positive-definite spectral frontier for two-coordinate discrete-potential absolute-value equations
